column1: # Round trip entries known to fail, checked by roundtrip.sh.
# Columns: version directory, snippet name, reason.

# gate, and an entry here that starts passing fails it too, so the list cannot
# quietly go stale. Shrinking this file is the point.
# They surfaced the first time these snippets were ever compiled. They are
# defects that predate the list, not regressions.
